create_with_date: Got it - I'll remind you about $content on $date.
create_content_only: When would you like to be reminded about $content?
What date or time should I set the reminder for $content?
missing_content: What would you like me to remind you about?
What do you want to be reminded of?

reminder_set.description: A boolean: true for a reminder created, or when a check finds reminders; false when a check finds none, and after a cancel

reminder_text.description: The text of the reminder created, as given; "" when none was given

reminder_time.description: The time of the reminder created, as given; "" when none was given

reminder_date.description: The date of the reminder created, as given; "" when none was given

reminder_texts.description: The text of each reminder a check found or a cancel removed, oldest first

reminder_times.description: The time of each reminder a check found or a cancel removed, oldest first

reminder_dates.description: The date of each reminder a check found or a cancel removed, oldest first; null for a reminder stored without one

reminder_count.description: How many reminders a check found

cancelled_count.description: How many reminders a cancel removed
